propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture mapping containing nonexistent project keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO instead of the canonical empty projects state.

Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action and Heartbeat Canary fail on every run since 2026-08-15T02:39Z because the fetcher multi-project fan-out queries jql_active for each mapped key, and project=LEG query is rejected by live Jira with 'value leg does not exist for field project' error.

The projects.json corruption was introduced via ad-hoc git commits on the live tickets branch (9f1b2cff98 and 275bd7507e) by test-fixture identity, bypassing the isolated rehearsal harness and unified store write lock.
Bridge-state write path (_write_record via set_project/remove_project) lacks write lock, auto-commit, and auto-push, enabling the ad-hoc hand-commits that caused the data leak.

Restoration of projects.json to canonical state {version:1, legacy_default:REB, projects:{}} and verification that rebar bridge preview against REB runs without JQL parse error and scheduled Reconcile Bridge runs succeed are required.
